16566-aunt-jane-s-nieces-abroad.title: Aunt Jane'S Nieces Abroad
16566-aunt-jane-s-nieces-abroad.creator: Edith Van Dyne
16566-aunt-jane-s-nieces-abroad.description: A book by Edith Van Dyne. The author is pleased to be able to present a sequel to "Aunt Jane's Nieces," the book which was received with so much favor last year. Yet it is not necessary one should have read the first book to fully understand the present volume, the characters being taken to entirely new scenes.

arxiv-1412-6358.title: Lagrangian solutions to the Vlasov-Poisson system with L 1 L^{1} density
arxiv-1412-6358.creator: Anna Bohun, François Bouchut, Gianluca Crippa
arxiv-1412-6358.description: Abstract . The recently developed theory of Lagrangian flows for transport equations with low regularity coefficients enables to consider non BV vector fields. We apply this theory to prove existence and stability of global Lagrangian solutions to the repulsive Vlasov-Poisson system with only integrable initial distribution function with finite energy. These solutions have a well-defined Lagrangian flow.

arxiv-1705-00094.title: The Impact of Coevolution and Abstention on the Emergence of Cooperation Thanks: The final version will be available at Studies in Computational Intelligence (SCI), Springer, 2017. Affiliation: Dept. of Information Technology, National University of Ireland, Galway, Ireland
arxiv-1705-00094.creator: Marcos Cardinot, Colm O’Riordan, Josephine Griffith
arxiv-1705-00094.description: Abstract This paper explores the Coevolutionary Optional Prisoner’s Dilemma (COPD) game, which is a simple model to coevolve game strategy and link weights of agents playing the Optional Prisoner’s Dilemma game. We consider a population of agents placed in a lattice grid with boundary conditions.

arxiv-2104-03848.title: Exploring the Relationship Between Algorithm Performance, Vocabulary, and Run-Time in Text Classification
arxiv-2104-03848.creator: Wilson Fearn, Orion Weller, Kevin Seppi
arxiv-2104-03848.description: Abstract Text classification is a significant branch of natural language processing, and has many applications including document classification and sentiment analysis. Unsurprisingly, those who do text classification are concerned with the run-time of their algorithms, many of which depend on the size of the corpus’ vocabulary due to their bag-of-words representation.

arxiv-2112-15200.title: Molecular reorganization energy in quantum-dot cellular automata switching
arxiv-2112-15200.creator: Craig S. Lent, Subhash S. Pidaparthi
arxiv-2112-15200.description: Abstract We examine the impact of the intrinsic molecular reorganization energy on switching in two-state quantum-dot cellular automata (QCA) cells. Switching a bit involves an electron transferring between charge centers within the molecule. This in turn causes the other atoms in the molecule to rearrange their positions in response.

arxiv-2205-11074.title: Entanglement and work extraction in the central-spin quantum battery
arxiv-2205-11074.creator: Jia-Xuan Liu, Hai-Long Shi, Yun-Hao Shi, Xiao-Hui Wang, Wen-Li Yang
arxiv-2205-11074.description: Abstract We consider a central-spin battery where N b N_{b} central spins serve as battery cells and N c N_{c} bath spins serve as charging units. It is shown that the energy stored in the battery that can be extractable is quantified by the ergotropy, and that battery-charger entanglement is quantified via the Von Neumann entropy.

arxiv-2210-08175.title: DataTV: Streaming Data Videos for Storytelling
arxiv-2210-08175.creator: Zhenpeng Zhao, Niklas Elmqvist
arxiv-2210-08175.description: Abstract Data videos—motion graphics that incorporate visualizations—have been recognized as an effective way to communicate ideas, but creating such video requires both time and expertise, precluding them from being created and streamed live. We introduce DataTV, a system for combining multiple media sources in real time.

arxiv-2305-02862.title: Entanglement as a sufficient condition for quantum synchronization between two mechanical oscillators
arxiv-2305-02862.creator: Manju, Shubhrangshu Dasgupta, and Asoka Biswas
arxiv-2305-02862.description: Abstract We present an optomechanical model to show that entanglement can be a sufficient condition for quantum synchronization of two mechanical oscillators. As both these entities can be characterized in terms of variances of a set of EPR-like conjugate quadratures, we investigate whether this leads to a specific condition for simultaneous existence of the both.

arxiv-2405-19546.title: Convex Optimization of Initial Perturbations toward Quantitative Weather Control
arxiv-2405-19546.creator: Toshiyuki Ohtsuka, Atsushi Okazaki, Masaki Ogura, and Shunji Kotsuki
arxiv-2405-19546.description: Abstract This study proposes introducing convex optimization to find initial perturbations of atmospheric states to realize specified changes in subsequent weather. In the proposed method, we formulate and solve an inverse problem to find effective perturbations in atmospheric variables so that controlled variables satisfy specified changes at a specified time.

arxiv-2409-13764.title: Local Explanations and Self-Explanations for Assessing Faithfulness in black-box LLMs
arxiv-2409-13764.creator: Christos Fragkathoulas, Odysseas S. Chlapanis
arxiv-2409-13764.description: Abstract . This paper introduces a novel task to assess the faithfulness of large language models (LLMs) using local perturbations and self-explanations. Many LLMs often require additional context to answer certain questions correctly. For this purpose, we propose a new efficient alternative explainability technique, inspired by the commonly used leave-one-out approach.

arxiv-2505-12119.title: Self-similar renormalization for nonlinear problems
arxiv-2505-12119.description: Abstract A new method, called the method of self-similar approximants, and its recent developments are described. The method is based on the ideas of renormalization group theory and optimal control theory. It allows for the effective extrapolation of asymptotic series in powers of small variables to the finite and even to infinite variables. The approach is proved to be regular.

arxiv-2506-07666.title: ProARD: Progressive Adversarial Robustness Distillation: Provide Wide Range of Robust Students
arxiv-2506-07666.creator: Seyedhamidreza Mousavi, Seyedali Mousavi, Masoud Daneshtalab
arxiv-2506-07666.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Seyedhamidreza Mousavi, Seyedali Mousavi, Masoud Daneshtalab. Adversarial Robustness Distillation (ARD) has emerged as an effective method to enhance the robustness of lightweight deep neural networks against adversarial attacks. Current ARD approaches have leveraged a large robust teacher network to train one robust lightweight student. However, due to the diverse range of edge devices and resource constraints, current approaches require training a new student network from scratch to meet specific constraints, leading to substantial computational costs and increased CO 2 emissions.

Although a precise and unique cut-off value has not been yet found, its role as a flag of immune system...

pmc-11316771.creator: Chen Chen, Liang Wang, Weiyi Xia, Ke Qiu, Chuanhang Guo, Zirui Gan, Jing Zhou, Yuandong Sun, Dan Liu, Wei Li, Tao Wang

The nanoscale fibrillar morphology, featuring long-range structural order, provides abundant interfaces for efficient exciton dissociation and high-quality pathways for effective charge transport, is a promising morphology for high performance organic solar cells. Here, we synthesize a thiophene terminated non-fullerene acceptor, L8-ThCl, to induce the fibrillization of both polymer donor and host acceptor, that surpasses the 20% efficiency milestone of organic solar cells. pmc-11565634.title: Clinical burden of community-associated infections caused by multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa: a propensity-matched longitudinal cohort study in Southern China
pmc-11565634.creator: Mouqing Zhou, Baohua Xu, Zhusheng Guo, Yongfeng Zeng, Jiayao Lei, Evangelos I Kritsotakis, Jiancong Wang
pmc-11565634.description: Background: Limited research has been conducted on the burden of community-associated infections caused by multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa (CA-MDRPa). We quantitatively modeled the incidence rate and clinical factors associated with CA-MDRPa among hospitalized patients in Southern China.Methods: Data were obtained from the local nosocomial surveillance system. Poisson regression was applied to estimate annual incidence rate ratios (IRRs) from 2018 to 2021.

pmc-11665477.title: Synovial mast cells and osteoarthritis: Current understandings and future perspectives
pmc-11665477.creator: Guanghui Hao, Shanqian Han, Zhangang Xiao, Jing Shen, Yueshui Zhao, Qi Hao
pmc-11665477.description: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent joint disease worldwide that significantly impacts the quality of life of individuals, particularly those in middle-aged and elderly populations. OA was initially considered as non-inflammatory arthritis, but recent studies have identified a substantial number of immune responses in OA, leading to the recognition of inflammation as a key factor in its pathogenesis.

pmc-11675537.title: Consensus in Action: Context-Specific Physical Activity Guidelines for Undergraduate Students at a South African University
pmc-11675537.creator: Chanté Johannes, Nicolette V Roman, Sunday O Onagbiye, Simone Titus, Lloyd L Leach, Paul B Tchounwou
pmc-11675537.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Physical inactivity among undergraduate university students has been considered a public health concern. To address this, researchers have utilized consensus workshop approaches to develop effective physical activity (PA) recommendations. However, the existing research has limitations: it is outdated, not context-specific to young adults, and does not account for psychosocial factors (such as mental health, motivation, and social support) that hinder or promote PA behavior, particularly in South Africa.

pmc-11716087.title: Plasma N‐terminal tau fragment is associated with cognitive status and AD biomarkers of tau and neurodegeneration in older adults
pmc-11716087.creator: Yiwen Rao, Beth L Ostaszewski, Amirah K Anderson, Zahra Shirzadi, Lei Liu, Hyun‐Sik Yang, Jasmeer P Chhatwal, Dennis J Selkoe, Stephanie A Schultz, ADNI
pmc-11716087.description: BackgroundThe emergence of blood‐based biomarkers offers a cost‐effective and less invasive alternative to established neuroimaging and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers. Newly developed fluid biomarkers, including N‐terminal tau fragment (NT1), have shown promise for identifying individuals at risk for Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

pmc-12409409.title: Clinical characteristics and in-hospital mortality of chronic myeloid leukemia patients with ischemic heart disease: insights from the JROAD-DPC registry

pmc-12409409.description: AimsChronic myeloid leukemia (CML) patients are at high risk for developing cardiovascular (CV) diseases due to adverse effects of BCR-ABL tyrosine kinase inhibitors.ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to compare patient characteristics and in-hospital mortality between CML patients and non-CML patients, who were hospitalized for ischemic heart disease (IHD).

pmc-12664622.title: Angiography-Derived Versus Coronary Guidewire-Derived Index of Microcirculatory Resistance in Patients With Ischemia With Nonobstructive Coronary Arteries
pmc-12664622.creator: Ethan Loftspring, Peter Zhang, William Beaty, Anaïs Hausvater, Amanda Joa, Kenneth L. Harkin, Claudia Serrano-Gomez, Ayman Farid, Lindsay Elbaum, Jeffrey S. Berger, Harmony R. Reynolds, Nathaniel R. Smilowitz
pmc-12664622.description: BackgroundCoronary function testing (CFT) during invasive coronary angiography is guideline-recommended to identify coronary microvascular dysfunction (CMD) in patients with ischemia with nonobstructive coronary arteries (INOCA). Wire-free, angiography-derived index of microcirculatory resistance (IMRangio) measurements have been developed to simplify assessment for CMD.

pmc-12713285.title: Trends of sexual behaviors and related factors in high-risk MSM from 2010 to 2023: a repeated cross-sectional study in Zhejiang, China
pmc-12713285.creator: Wenwen Liu, Xiaoxiao Chen, Shanling Wang, Yating Wang, Haijiang Lin, Ye Yao
pmc-12713285.description: BackgroundSpecific high-risk subgroups of men who have sex with men (MSM) play crucial roles in sexually transmitted infection (STI) transmission. This study investigated temporal trends in sexual behaviors and associated factors among bisexual MSM, active MSM, and active MSM in bisexuality.

pmc-13003059.title: Liquid–liquid phase separation in neural development
pmc-13003059.creator: Sara Surini, Ivan de Curtis
pmc-13003059.description: Liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS) is a physicochemical process in which a homogeneous mixture of molecules separates into a denser phase originating from preferential self-assembly, driven by multivalent interactions, frequently mediated by intrinsically disordered protein regions, RNAs, or structured modular domains. LLPS produces a large variety of nuclear or cytoplasmic membrane-less biomolecular condensates with liquid-like properties.

pmc-13330957.title: The development of a Patient Decision Aid and Patient Concerns Inventory for people diagnosed with recurrent head and neck cancer: a mixed-methods study protocol
pmc-13330957.creator: Sofia Georgopoulou, Grainne Brady, Mark Fuller, Michael Thick, Susanne Cruickshank, Vinidh Paleri, Justin Roe
pmc-13330957.description: IntroductionHistorically, patients diagnosed with recurrent head and neck cancer (rHNC) had a poor prognosis with the majority receiving best supportive care. Significant treatment advances over the past decade have changed the landscape for curative and non-curative management of rHNC with more treatment options for patients.

pmc-13379374.title: Astrocyte reactivity by alcohol dependence in the central amygdala
pmc-13379374.creator: Joel G Hashimoto, Angela E Gonzalez, Natalie Gorham, Zoe Barbour, Amanda J Roberts, Le Z Day, Hermina Nedelescu, Maci Heal, Brett A Davis, Lucia Carbone, Jon Jacobs, Marisa Roberto, Marina Guizzetti
pmc-13379374.description: Astrocytes play essential roles in maintaining brain homeostasis and in contributing to synaptic functions, but, in response to injury, infection, or disease, astrocytes can downregulate their homeostatic and physiological functions while increasing neuroinflammatory responses. The central amygdala (CeA) is important for stress responsivity and the development of alcohol (ethanol) dependence.

pmc-13395905.creator: Marina Gasparini, Nicola Vanacore, Valentina Moro

pmc-13500729.title: 慢性失眠障碍患者钙调蛋白、神经递质与多导睡眠图的相关性
pmc-13500729.creator: 婷 苏, 海萍 张, 彪 王, 芳玲 刘, 玲 蒋, 雅心 杨, 梅 袁
pmc-13500729.description: 目的慢性失眠障碍(chronic insomnia disorder，CID)是一种常见的睡眠障碍性疾病，可引起多种健康问题。神经递质，尤其是γ-氨基丁酸(gamma-aminobutyric acid，GABA)、谷氨酸(glutamic acid，Glu)、5-羟色胺(5-hydroxytryptamine，5-HT)在睡眠调节中发挥关键作用，而钙调蛋白(calmodulin，CaM)参与其调控过程。然而，目前尚缺乏关于CaM及相关神经递质水平与多导睡眠图(polysomnography，PSG)参数间相关性的系统性研究，上述指标对CID的诊断价值亦不明确。本研究旨在比较CID患者与健康体检者的上述生化指标差异，分析其与PSG参数的相关性，并评估其对CID的诊断效能，以期为CID的辅助诊断提供新的血液生物标志物，并探索其临床应用潜力。方法纳入2017年1月至2019年4月于南华大学附属第二医院神经内科就诊的CID患者103例，同期的健康体检者102例为健康对照(healthy controls，HCs)。采用双抗体夹心酶联免疫吸附试验(enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay，ELISA)检测2组血清GABA、Glu、5-HT水平，比较2组差异，并分析上述指标与PSG参数的相关性，进一步绘制受试者操作特征(receiver operating characteristic，ROC)曲线评估其诊断效能。结果与HCs组相比，CID组血清CaM、GABA、5-HT水平和GABA与Glu的比值(GABA/Glu)均显著降低，而Glu水平显著升高(均P<0.05)。在CID组，血清GABA/Glu与N3期睡眠持续时间呈正相关(r=0.225，P=0.022)，血清5-HT水平与睡眠效率呈正相关(r=0.215，P=0.029)。血清CaM、GABA/Glu和5-HT诊断CID的曲线下面积(areas under the curve，AUC)分别为0.616、0.609和0.790(均P<0.05)。其中，5-HT的诊断效能最佳，AUC为0.790；当血清5-HT水平低于125.249 ng/mL时，诊断CID的准确率达79.0%。基于上述3个指标构建的Logistic回归联合诊断模型可显著提升诊断效能，AUC[95% 置信区间(confidence interval，CI)]达0.800(0.739~0.861)，敏感度为81.4%，特异度为68.0%(P<0.01)。结论CID患者血清CaM、GABA、5-HT水平和GABA/Glu均显著降低，Glu水平显著升高。CID患者血清GABA/Glu与N3期持续时间呈正相关，5-HT水平与睡眠效率呈正相关。血清CaM、GABA/Glu及5-HT对CID具有诊断价值，基于3者的联合诊断模型的诊断效能强于单个指标。 慢性失眠障碍(chronic insomnia disorder，CID)是临床上最常见的睡眠障碍之一，以入睡困难、睡眠维持困难或早醒为主要特征，并伴有日间功能损害。作为一种常见的睡眠障碍，CID全球成人的患病率约为1/3[1]，可引发多种健康问题，包括认知功能减退[2]、焦虑抑郁[3]、免疫功能紊乱[4]、肥胖风险增加[5]、衰弱[6]等。 研究[7-8]表明，神经递质在睡眠调节中起关键作用。γ-氨基丁酸(gamma-aminobutyric acid，GABA)是广泛存在的抑制性神经递质，而谷氨酸(glutamic acid，Glu)作为主要兴奋性神经递质，可在谷氨酸脱羧酶的作用下转化为GABA。二者共同调控睡眠-觉醒周期，其功能紊乱可能导致睡眠障碍。GABA与Glu的比值(GABA/Glu)可用来评估中枢神经系统功能兴奋-抑制平衡[9]。5-羟色胺(5-hydroxytryptamine，5-HT)，又称血清素，作为“睡眠诱导因子”，参与睡眠启动与维持、认知、情绪调节等功能[10]，其水平变化与睡眠密切相关[11-12]。钙调蛋白(calmodulin，CaM)是一种高度保守的钙结合蛋白。近年来，越来越多的研究[13-14]提示钙信号通路在睡眠-觉醒调控中发挥关键作用。研究[15-17]证实，Ca2+/CaM依赖性通路对睡眠具有重要的调节作用，且CaM参与神经递质调控过程。多导睡眠图(polysomnography，PSG)是客观量化CID患者睡眠结构、识别主客观睡眠差异的临床金标准。然而，目前缺乏CaM及神经递质(GABA、Glu、5-HT)与CID患者PSG参数的相关性研究，亦未明确其对CID的诊断价值。 本研究旨在比较CID患者与健康对照者血清CaM、GABA、Glu及5-HT水平差异，分析上述血液指标与PSG参数的相关性，并评估CaM、GABA/Glu及5-HT对CID的诊断价值。 对象与方法 伦理声明 本研究为横断面研究，研究方案已获南华大学附属第二医院(以下简称“我院”)伦理委员会批准(审批号：2016-02-0001)。所有研究对象均签署书面知情同意书。 对象 纳入2017年1月至2019年4月于我院神经内科就诊的103例CID患者为CID组，另在我院体检中心招募同期健康体检者作为健康对照(healthy controls，HCs)组。所有研究对象均由2名经过培训的高年资神经内科医师根据国际睡眠障碍分类第3版修订本(International Classification of Sleep Disorders, 3rd Edition: Text Revision，ICSD-3-TR)[18]中慢性失眠的诊断标准进行评估。 CID组纳入标准：1)年龄为18~80岁；2)符合ICSD-3-TR中慢性失眠的诊断标准；3)经PSG确诊；4)受教育年限≥7年，无认知理解障碍；5)签署知情同意书。 HCs组纳入标准：1)年龄为18~80岁；2)匹兹堡睡眠质量指数(Pittsburgh sleep quality index，PSQI)评分≤5且无失眠相关主诉；3)受教育年限≥7年，无认知理解障碍；4)签署知情同意书。 CID组及HCs组排除标准：1)合并神经系统疾病(如急性脑卒中、癫痫、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病)；2)合并中重度精神疾病(如抑郁、焦虑)；3)合并其他睡眠障碍(如不宁腿综合征、睡眠行为异常、中重度阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停低通气综合征)；4)近期有重大情感创伤史或使用精神活性药物；5)处于妊娠期或哺乳期。为控制人口学变量的影响，对HCs组与CID组研究对象在年龄、性别上进行了匹配。 方法 一般临床资料收集 收集所有参与者的性别、年龄等人口统计学特征。 血清样本采集与检测 采集所有参与者清晨空腹肘前静脉血3 mL，以3 000 r/min离心20 min，收集血清0.

uslaw-usc-t7-s176.title: 7 U.S.C. § 176 — Sale of guayule shrub to Reconstruction Finance Corporation
uslaw-usc-t7-s176.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s176.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 8A (Rubber And Other Critical Agricultural Materials); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Guayule shrub may be sold to the Reconstruction Finance Corporation at a price reflecting the net realization from the sale of the rubber recovered from such shrub in mills operated by said Corporation after deducting the cost of milling.
